CHOICE: NONE

I don't think any of the three solutions gives the right threshold. My recollection of the literature on proper conflict-free list-coloring is that the threshold is 7/3, not 18/7, 36/11, or 18/5. I can't verify that from memory, so this rests on recall rather than a derivation.

The three arguments also don't hold up on their own terms. Their reducibility claims are asserted rather than proved, and the discharging rules are chosen to hit a target value without checking that the reductions justify them. Solution 2 invokes a "refined analysis" it never carries out, and Solution 3 doesn't check that its 3-vertex charges balance. The tightness claims are unsupported as well.

CONFIDENCE: 3
